title: ResumePermissionParams
description:
Body of the `session/resume_permission` request.

Pairs the in-flight request id with the user's [`ResumeOutcome`]. The `request_id` echoes the id the server surfaced when it suspended the turn (carried by [`TurnSuspendedNotification::request_id`]).

# Examples

``` use zhive_proto::permission::{ResumeOutcome, ResumePermissionParams}; let payload = r#"{ "requestId": "perm:1", "outcome": { "outcome": "selected", "optionId": "allow_once" } }"#; let params: ResumePermissionParams = serde_json::from_str(payload).unwrap(); assert_eq!(params.request_id, "perm:1"); assert!(matches!(params.outcome, ResumeOutcome::Selected { .. })); ```

requestId.description: Pending request id echoed from the suspend notification.
